corrections.new: Reliable, but you must already have access to a working U.S. phone number to sign up. The free personal Google Voice cannot call 911 (only paid Voice Starter/Standard and work or school accounts can). Use any phone's own dialer for 911. Any phone can call 911, even with no service plan.
corrections.method: WebFetch of Google Voice Help "Call emergency services": emergency calling is only available for Workspace add-on, Voice Starter and Voice Standard accounts; not available in a power, internet or Voice outage
corrections.note: The old line ("does not support 911") is accurate for the free version this card describes; the new text says which accounts can.
